title: APRV with a release that lasts too long: derecruitment every breath
summary: Extrapulmonary ARDS (a recruitable, easily-collapsed lung under a stiff chest wall) on APRV 28/0 with a fixed 1.2 s release. Every release lets the dependent lung derecruit before the next Phigh reopens it: the tidal-recruitment badge and the truth layer's recruited-volume readout track it directly, and auto-PEEP and the schematic SpO2 track the same cycle. Ending the release at 75 % of the peak expiratory flow, instead of a fixed time, stops it before the lung closes, so the recruited volume holds instead of resetting every breath.
objectives: Read the tidal-recruitment badge and the recruited-volume readout on the truth layer while the release runs long, alongside auto-PEEP.
Fix by terminating the release on flow (75 % of PEFR) so the end-release pressure stays above closing and the recruited volume gain is sustained after the fix.

fix.note: Flow-terminated release (TCAV, 75 % of PEFR) with a 1.0 s cap: the release ends before the dependent lung closes.
